tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List providers tracked by the registry with their model counts. Use provider slugs in list_models / get_model / compare_models.

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Substring search across model name, slug, and provider — the fast path to a model's provider/slug pair for the detail tools.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List tracked models with pricing and context windows. Filter by provider, modality tag, status, or price/context bounds.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Full detail for one model (provider+slug from search_models): specs, current price, status, and recent price/availability snapshots.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2-10 models by provider/slug: context window, input/output price per 1M tokens, modalities, status.

tools.name: get_ingest_status
tools.description: Data-freshness check: registry totals and the most recent ingest runs (source, model count, status, time).
